scope: Bounded search of genuinely different public GitHub-hosted radio observations; not an exhaustive archive survey.
methods: Approved GitHub connector: repository trees, branch metadata, README files, code and code search
Web search for primary repository discovery; repository findings verified through GitHub connector

observation.publisher_description: Written by the ATA correlator to uvh5; downselected, normalized by autos and rewritten using pyuvdata. Two different subbands of the same observation.

candidates.availability_evidence: Git tree lists substantial ordinary blobs, not the small text blobs expected for Git LFS pointers. Binary content and headers have not been verified.
candidates.useful_scope: Potential future data-ingestion, interferometric and RFI quality-control exercise after a separate prospective plan.
limits: Two subbands are not two independent observations.
Processed visibility subsets are not native total-power SETI filterbank data.
Not a replacement for HIP44295 OFF5 and not candidate-search evidence.

observation.telescope: Ohio State University Radio Observatory / Big Ear
observation.publisher_description: PHL/UPR Arecibo transcription and reanalysis of the original printout; corrected coordinates, times and frequencies plus converted SNR and estimated flux.

limits: Known-event selection, not a fresh independent SETI candidate test.
Quantized printout-transcribed SNR is not original unquantized telescope power.
Flux scaling assumes a 54 Jy maximum according to the README.
No modern complete ON/OFF cadence and no repair of missing OFF5.
Tests identify 336 channels; examples expose the nonspecific source label src1.
Authoritative astronomical target identity was not established in this scout.
The two formats must not be assumed to represent independent observations.
No binary headers or data were inspected.
